summary: OWNER-INTAKE-EXPOSURE-01 (2026-10-02): the owner approved exposing the battery intake (OD-7(b), carbon/battery/intake.py) beyond loopback, for testnet 567, the battery Challenge and the routes and limits it serves today; the known items in BATTERY_MINER_SUBMISSION_PATHS.md stay recorded, not fixed. The listener already refused a public bind without an exposure record of this form; it now also refuses one that does not terminate TLS in the intake (intake_exposure_needs_tls), because the miner client refuses plain HTTP beyond loopback and a TLS proxy would make every request one peer. The repository's own record is held by a test. Exposing a host stays an operator action; this record permits it and performs none. Tests hold the gate and are not a security audit; no chain write is made.
